H0NC02125.name: Deborah Ross
H0NC02125.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 2nd District since 2021; civil rights lawyer and former N.C. House member who served more than ten years.

positions.stance: As Vice Ranking Member of the House Judiciary Committee, she "continues to fight for equality, justice, and progress."
Works "to make affordable health care more accessible to all North Carolinians."
Supports public education for all, reducing class sizes, raising teacher pay, investing in early childhood education, and alleviating student loan debt.
Advocates for policies "aimed to make housing more affordable for working people nationwide" and to protect the most vulnerable residents.
"Every American should be able to enjoy a comfortable and secure retirement"; works to protect hard-earned benefits.

H0NC03172.name: Greg Murphy
H0NC03172.bio: U.S. Representative and physician with a private practice in Greenville; ECU School of Medicine faculty member and former Chief of Staff of Vidant Medical Center.

positions.stance: "Making life more affordable for you is my top priority"; helped write and pass the Working Families Tax Cut, including No Tax on Tips and No Tax on Overtime.
Supports President Trump's actions to secure the border; "We must enforce our laws and crack down on these abuses."
Working to put "patients and their doctors back in the driver's seat" over healthcare monopolies and insurance companies; wants "a system that puts patients above profits."
Focused on justice for those affected by Camp Lejeune contaminated water, VA hyperbaric oxygen therapy access, and timely quality healthcare for veterans.
Says he "fought to make the Death Tax permanent to ensure that family farms stay family-owned"; supports expanding market access, fair H-2A labor rates, and cutting red tape.

H6NC03229.name: Raymond Smith Jr.
H6NC03229.bio: Former educator and football coach, Army combat veteran, NCDOT transportation planner, Wayne County school board member, and two-term N.C. state legislator.

positions.stance: Supports major campaign finance reform, ending Citizens United, and banning stock trading by members of Congress; "We must fight corruption from both parties in all forms."
Will focus on "lowering the cost of necessities and raising the standard of living for all North Carolinians" through affordability, job creation, and infrastructure.
Wants a healthcare system that brings down costs, expands access, and makes quality care affordable, including expanded access in rural areas.
Will fight for Eastern North Carolina's fair share of project funding, including broadband internet and major investments in floodwater resilience and prevention.
Supports improving the VA, expanding childcare access for service members' families, and addressing the base housing crisis.

H2NC06114.name: Valerie Foushee
H2NC06114.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 4th District and former North Carolina state senator.

positions.stance: Calls Donald Trump "the biggest threat to democracy our nation has ever faced" and will continue working to hold him responsible.
Working to limit ICE's authority, ban ICE agents from wearing masks, require body cameras, and crack down on agents who abuse their power.
Considers healthcare "a universal right"; supports extending Affordable Care Act subsidies, defending Medicaid, and Medicare for All.
Working to pass legislation to codify Roe and to protect access to contraceptives.
Opposes Trump's tariffs and corporate price gouging; supports legislation for affordable housing and to stop hedge funds from buying up local housing.

H4NC02150.name: Max Ganorkar
H4NC02150.bio: Runs a family-owned construction business and holds an M.B.A. in International Finance; previously worked on international joint ventures.

positions.stance: Supports school choice to end "zip-code segregation," including vouchers funding students directly through parents' tax returns and growth of private and vocational schools.
Proposes healthcare vouchers given to citizens through the tax-filing process to buy insurance, with catastrophic coverage as a minimum standard and interstate insurance purchasing.
Would reduce regulations that inflate construction costs, prevent corporations from buying single-family homes for rentals, and eliminate taxes on energy and food.
Opposes credit-based insurance scoring; says rates should be based on actual risk factors and "Insurance should measure risk, not poverty."
Says the U.S. Constitution "must not be altered to accommodate foreign laws or ideologies incompatible with a civilized society."

H4NC05146.name: Virginia Foxx
H4NC05146.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 5th Congressional District.

positions.stance: Supports banning elective abortion on unborn children "capable of feeling pain" and ending federal abortion funding; will "continue to fight for religious liberty."
Says reform should "secure our borders, uphold our laws, and protect our national security"; supports President Trump's efforts to enforce immigration laws.
"Dedicated to fighting government efforts that infringe on law-abiding citizens' Second Amendment rights."
Supports patient-centered solutions to lower costs and protect people with pre-existing conditions; opposes "Medicare for All."
Supports President Trump's work to "strengthen and rebuild our military" and consistently backs the National Defense Authorization Act.

H4NC05294.name: Chuck Hubbard
H4NC05294.bio: Wilkes County native and local journalist for over forty years.

positions.stance: Says Congress must address rising costs of health care, housing, child care, groceries, and utilities; "We need to raise the minimum wage" and shift the tax base toward the wealthy.
"Congress must do everything it can to support public education, teachers, and the physical infrastructure needed."
Wants to bring back good-paying jobs, support small businesses, strengthen agriculture, and expand high-speed broadband and infrastructure to rural communities.
Will "fight against any attacks on" Medicare, Medicaid, and Social Security.
Supports "a government option" to support rural health care infrastructure and keep prices low; says there should be a hospital within a short drive of every community.

H4NC06177.name: Addison McDowell
H4NC06177.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 6th District, first elected in 2024; former Constituent Liaison for Congressman Ted Budd.

positions.stance: "We must secure the Southern Border and stop the flow of illegal drugs from flooding into our country."
Supports President Trump's America First Agenda "that protects and promotes American jobs," citing harm from past free-trade policies.
Calls self-defense "a God-given, constitutional right" and will fight government overreach on Second Amendment rights.
"I will vote 100% pro-life and will champion pro-life causes and legislation in Congress," along with pro-family policies.
Opposes federalizing elections; supports tying federal grants to voter ID and tightening absentee voting with election-day receipt and signature verification.

H6NC06164.name: Cyril Jefferson
H6NC06164.bio: Former teacher and former mayor of High Point.

positions.stance: Plans to "bring down costs, making the American Dream achievable for all," building on his record of creating affordable housing.
Will protect Medicaid and Medicare, lower drug costs, expand mental-health care, and tackle hunger through SNAP and farm-to-school programs.
Believes government "must be accountable to the people and constrained by the Constitution"; will defend democratic guardrails and support accountable public safety investments.
Will raise teacher pay, expand affordable childcare, and create debt-free career pathways through apprenticeships.
Will bring federal dollars home to modernize roads, rail, and broadband, support small businesses and farmers, and boost housing supply.

H2NC07096.name: David Rouzer
H2NC07096.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 7th District since 2014; former two-term N.C. state senator and business consultant.

positions.stance: Will seek long-term funding for dredging waterways and inlets and beach nourishment, and work to protect the federal flood insurance program.
Supports "Peace through Strength," a cutting-edge military, military intervention only when U.S. national interest is threatened, and a strong alliance with Israel.
Wants to remove onerous regulations, repeal Obamacare, reform the tax code, and pursue an all-of-the-above energy policy for energy independence.
"I am a firm believer that less government is best"; will support a balanced budget amendment.
"We cannot tax our way back to prosperity"; says "We need to lower all taxes" to reinvigorate the economy.
Supports raising the federal minimum wage, closing the "salary loophole" on overtime, and eliminating taxes on tips; backs small business loans and infrastructure projects.
Will work to ensure clean drinking water, fund coastal resilience infrastructure, support solar, wind, and geothermal energy, and keep FEMA funding accessible.
Will "Protect Medicare and Medicaid," keep premiums affordable, lower prescription drug costs, and roll back cuts to NIH and NSF research.
Will protect funds for students with disabilities, Head Start, Title I, and Career & Technical Education, and advocate capital improvement funds for schools.

H6NC09200.name: Mark Harris
H6NC09200.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 8th District and a pastor.

positions.stance: Believes "in the sanctity of all human life, from conception to natural end" and advocates measures upholding traditional family values.
Committed to "fortifying our borders, supporting advanced technology, and rigorously enforcing our immigration laws."
Emphasizes "the need for a formidable military that deters threats, stands with allies," and honors servicemembers during and after service.
Supports strong public schools but believes "parents, not the Federal Government, should have the final say" in their children's education, including school choice.
Believes "the foundation of a safe community is the unwavering enforcement of our laws" and holding criminals accountable.

H6NC08202.name: Colby Watson
H6NC08202.bio: Small business owner for more than a decade who previously worked in masonry, construction, and farming.

positions.stance: Would stop Wall Street firms and large institutional investors from buying up neighborhoods, cut red tape blocking new homes, and support first-time homebuyer programs.
Supports cutting red tape on small businesses and trades, supporting American manufacturing, and funding apprenticeships, trade schools, and job training.
"Healthcare should be about healing people, not maximizing profits"; supports stronger antitrust enforcement, protecting rural hospitals, and lowering prescription drug costs.
Supports banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks and a constitutional amendment to overturn the effects of Citizens United.
Supports funding strong local public schools, paying teachers "what the job is worth," keeping decisions with parents and communities, and fully funding special education.

H2NC08185.name: Richard Hudson
H2NC08185.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 9th District and member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

positions.stance: Supports law enforcement, finishing border security "with wall and technology," reinstating policies like "Remain in Mexico," and ending the opioid epidemic.
Founding member of the Conservative Climate Caucus championing "free-market ideas to reduce emissions"; has worked to address PFAS chemicals including GenX.
Seeks to dismantle the "top-down, government-heavy approach" of the ACA while keeping pre-existing condition protections, bolstering health savings accounts, and increasing price transparency.
Says he "will always have the backs of our veterans"; cites expanding the GI Bill and VA access for veterans exposed to toxic burn pits.
Advocates for troops and their families, including pay raises, more training funding, and resources for soldiers recovering from battlefield wounds.

H6NC09218.name: Richard Ojeda
H6NC09218.bio: Retired U.S. Army Major who served 24 years.

positions.stance: Will "block efforts to gut departments that serve veterans, students, and families," and work to keep rural hospitals open.
Wants to stop cuts to the VA workforce, "Protect pensions and benefits veterans have already earned," and prioritize mental health care for veterans and families.
Will defend the Department of Education and public schools, supports the Pay Teachers Act and a national teacher pay floor of at least $60,000.
"Clean water and public land are not negotiable"; would crack down on corporate pollution, hold polluters accountable for PFAS, and build climate resilience infrastructure.
Would "Replace ICE with an accountable and lawful immigration enforcement system," crack down on cartels, and support lawful, humane immigration reform.

H2NC13243.name: Pat Harrigan
H2NC13243.bio: West Point graduate and former Army Green Beret who co-founded a firearms and defense products manufacturing business in Western North Carolina.

positions.stance: Fighting "to curb inflation, cut wasteful spending, decrease taxes, and lower energy prices."
Supports "an all-of-the-above approach to energy," including domestic oil, pipelines, fracking, nuclear, solar, wind, and coal, to achieve energy independence.
"We must reinvest in our military, and give our soldiers the tools and support they need," and reestablish America as the world's leading superpower.
Working with the Trump Administration "to secure our border and enforce Federal law," and to provide Border Patrol agents every necessary resource.
Will "fight to protect our right to keep and bear arms," supports Constitutional carry, and rejects red flag measures.

H6NC10174.name: Ashley Bell
H6NC10174.bio: Physician Associate with 15 years in medicine and a former public school teacher and university professor.

positions.stance: Backs universal coverage with benefits "untethered from your job"; will legislate to end prior authorization and stop insurers from denying medically necessary care.
Believes "data centers should pay their own way, with enforceable limits on water and power use and no cost shifted onto our electric bills."
Will demand congressional oversight and "hold all three branches of government accountable."
Supports a national minimum wage and targeted relief for unavoidable costs; will work to end "the tariff whiplash."
"Insurance companies shouldn't have more say over your care than your doctor"; will hold them accountable to patients.

H6NC11248.name: Jamie Ager
H6NC11248.bio: Fourth-generation farmer who with his wife has built Hickory Nut Gap farm business in Western North Carolina over 25 years.

positions.stance: "In Congress, my top priority will be delivering recovery funds"; wants to cut red tape to get money to people and small businesses.
Supports robust Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security, Medicare drug price negotiation and insulin caps, a public option, and improved mental health support.
Supports first-time homebuyer programs, energy-saving tax credits, taking on monopolization, expanding the child tax credit, and tax reform so "the folks at the top pay their fair share."
Backs campaign finance reforms on dark money, banning members of Congress from stock trading, and stronger ethics and anti-corruption rules.
Supports comprehensive immigration reform that is "clear, fair, and realistic," treats people with dignity, and gives businesses the workforce they need.

H6NC11321.name: Jennifer Balkcom
H6NC11321.bio: Mortgage loan officer and small-business owner with more than 25 years in banking and finance who represents Henderson County in the North Carolina House.

H4NC12100.name: Alma Adams
H4NC12100.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 12th District and a retired professor.

positions.stance: "I will always fight for a woman's right to choose and the right to privacy"; supports the Paycheck Fairness Act for equal pay.
Opposes "any school voucher program"; supports public school funding, increased Pell Grants, lower student loan interest rates, and student debt cancellation.
"Health insurance needs to be affordable and available for everyone"; supports pre-existing condition protections, income-based insurance discounts, and closing the Medicaid coverage gap.
Supports middle-class tax cuts, small business tax cuts, and raising the minimum wage indexed to inflation.
"I'll fight against any attempt to privatize Social Security or defund Medicare."
Would "abolish the Federal Reserve and place oversight under the U.S. Treasury" and return to a monetary system backed by gold and silver.
Would eliminate tax incentives treating homes as investments, limit zoning to infrastructure or pollution concerns, and supports "a nationwide ban on property taxes."
"We must eliminate government-guaranteed student loans and allow borrowers to declare bankruptcy under existing law."
Would "reform and phase out all welfare programs, including Social Security," government healthcare, and government-backed mortgages.
Says property and income taxes should be abolished and America "should adopt simpler, consumption-based taxes and tariffs."

H4NC13116.name: Brad Knott
H4NC13116.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 13th District and former federal prosecutor.

positions.stance: "We must secure the border, finish the wall, and enforce the law"; says illegal immigrants who commit felonies should serve at least five years, then be deported.
Supports school choice "so parents can get their children out of failing schools" and says parents must have a voice in curriculum.
Calls for cutting spending and scrutinizing every spending bill; supports "a balanced budget amendment to the Constitution."
Will "fight to end cancel culture, protect freedom of speech," and stop targeting of Christian conservatives.
"I proudly and unapologetically 'Back the Blue' 100%."

H6NC13228.name: Paul Barringer
H6NC13228.bio: Lawyer who lives on a farm in Lee County.

positions.stance: Believes "every American should have access to affordable, quality healthcare"; supports reforms to reduce waste and continued support for Medicare and Medicaid.
Supports strengthening ties with allies and democracies; says "We should not cozy up to dictatorships or authoritarian regimes."
"I believe in a secure border and a fair, legal immigration system"; supports effective enforcement and modernizing legal immigration to meet workforce needs.
Believes in "fiscal discipline and living within our means"; calls for spending restraint and working toward a balanced budget.
Supports public schools and teachers while giving parents "a real seat at the table," plus youth service programs combining education, vocational training, and community service.

H4NC14015.name: Tim Moore
H4NC14015.bio: U.S. Representative for North Carolina's 14th District; spent more than two decades in the N.C. General Assembly, including ten years as Speaker of the House.

H6NC14069.name: LaKesha Womack
H6NC14069.bio: Consultant, minister, and Chief Strategy Officer of an emerging CDFI with more than two decades in financial services and small business development.

positions.stance: "Health care is a basic necessity, not a privilege"; will protect the Affordable Care Act, support caps on out-of-pocket and drug costs, and fund rural hospitals.
Supports raising the federal minimum wage and tax policies that benefit working- and middle-class households, and opposes regressive tax structures.
Will expand access to capital through CDFIs and community lenders and increase federal procurement opportunities for small businesses.
Supports affordable housing investment, opposes 50-year mortgages, and will protect renters and first-time homebuyers.
Will increase federal investment in public schools, expand apprenticeships, and support affordable higher education and student debt relief.

H6MI01226.name: Jack Bergman
H6MI01226.bio: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 1st District and retired Marine Corps Lieutenant General after 40 years of service.

positions.stance: Says he "will continue working to connect rural America," including legislation requiring the FCC to prioritize broadband applications in areas with short construction seasons.
Focused on improving veterans' health care, preventing veteran suicide, protecting earned benefits, and holding the Department of Veterans Affairs accountable.
Will "continue fighting for Michigan producers, family farms"; supports year-round E15 sales and preventing China-connected entities from buying U.S. farmland.
Believes Congress must protect the right to life "including for the unborn"; supports prohibiting federal abortion funding and preserving the Hyde Amendment.
Believes the military "must be strong enough to deter our adversaries and ready to decisively defeat any threat to our Nation."

H4MI01155.name: Callie Barr
H4MI01155.bio: Teacher and attorney who became a veterans advocate after caring for her husband, a Marine wounded in combat.

positions.stance: Supports federal funding for affordable local homebuilding, practical zoning reform, and balancing short-term rentals with the needs of full-time residents.
Wants to "Make the ultrawealthy pay their fair share," protect Social Security and remove the cap, expand broadband, and pass the PRO Act.
Would end tariffs that hurt farmers and raise food prices, expand mobile markets in food deserts, and reverse SNAP cuts.
Would protect Medicaid and rural hospitals, extend ACA subsidies with "a strong public option," lower drug costs through negotiation, and fully fund the VA.

H4MI04126.name: John Moolenaar
H4MI04126.bio: U.S. Representative for Michigan's 2nd District, chair of the House Select Committee on China, and member of the House Appropriations Committee.

positions.stance: Committed to "secure the border, cut wasteful Washington spending, rebuild our military, grow our economy and defend the dignity and value of every human life."
Works to "hold the CCP accountable," including preventing adversaries from buying American farmland and protecting Michigan communities from foreign threats.
"I will always defend the 2nd Amendment, protect the unborn."
Will make sure "our veterans have the benefits they deserve, and our farmers have the workers they need."
Will "make sure Social Security and Medicare are preserved"; cites cutting taxes on these benefits for seniors.

H6MI02216.name: Benjamin Ambrose
H6MI02216.bio: Marine Corps infantryman for nearly 20 years who grew up on a farm in Hesperia.

positions.stance: Would hold corporations accountable for price gouging on groceries and gas, support small businesses, strengthen collective bargaining, and bring back manufacturing through "Buy American" policies.
Supports increased federal funding for public schools, smaller classes, expanded Pell Grants, vocational training, and better teacher pay.
"Ben proudly supports Medicare for All"; also supports strengthening the ACA, lowering drug costs, and access to reproductive healthcare.
Wants veterans to have the best possible health care, improved VA systems, and expanded access to mental health care.
Would protect the Great Lakes from pollution and invasive species, transition to clean energy, and support sustainable agriculture.
